messages.content: I'll research this in parallel across the key dimensions: Unicode/script normalization standards, bidi handling, homoglyph/mixed-script detection, noise robustness testing, and code-switching stress-testing.

subtopics: Unicode normalization forms NFC NFD NFKC NFKD for localization pipelines: UAX #15, when to apply, ordering with other cleaning steps, handling of zero-width characters, control characters, and mojibake repair (ftfy) best practices

Bidirectional text handling in localized UIs and NLP pipelines: UAX #9 bidi algorithm, base direction detection, first-strong heuristic, isolates FSI/PDI vs embedding marks, W3C/WHATWG dir=auto and bdi guidance, common bidi bugs in mixed LTR/RTL text

Mixed-script and homoglyph detection: UTS #39 confusables and restricted scripts, Greek/Cyrillic homoglyph spoofing, CJK fullwidth/halfwidth width folding, IDN spoofing defenses, transliteration vs normalization tradeoffs

Stress-testing NLP and MT systems with noise: robustness benchmarks, noise injection methods (typos, casing, whitespace, character swaps), adversarial text augmentation tools (nlpaug, TextAttack, textflint), evaluation metrics for robustness

Code-switching stress tests for multilingual NLP: Hinglish/Spanglish/Arabic-French datasets and benchmarks, transliteration code-switching, MT and LLM performance on mixed-language text, evaluation approaches
